findings.pdf_says: Each successive element within that dimension of the table is referenced by occurrence numbers of 2, 3, ... . The highest permissible occurrence number for any given dimension of a fixed-capacity or occurs-depending table is the maximum number of occurrences of the item as specified in the associated OCCURS clause.

findings.why_it_matters: General rule 2 of 8.4.1.2.3 is one paragraph in the PDF; the markdown breaks it mid-sentence with a blank line and hard line breaks, so the rest of the rule (the dynamic-capacity limit and the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT condition) renders as a separate indented paragraph detached from rule 2. No words are lost.
